raw_segments.text: But Nidai, he exclaimed, must I?
No one has been condemned, no one has been sent to Siberia in my place, the man died
And I've been punished by my sufferings for the blood I shed.
And I shan't be believed, they won't believe my proofs.
Nidai confess, Nidai, I am ready to go on suffering all my life for the blood I have
shed if only my wife and children may be spared.
Will it be just to ruin them with me?
What is right in this case?
